record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.original_question: For a globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter manifold M = S × R with closed surface S of genus at least 2, is either the total volume V(M) or the convex-core volume V(C(M)) quasi-equivalent to a natural distance, such as the Teichmüller distance or the Weil–Petersson distance, between the induced metrics on the convex-core boundary or between the left and right hyperbolic metrics?

evidence.quote: Question 4.1. Is V (M) or V (C(M)) quasi-equivalent to a distance (for instance the Teichmüller distance, or the Weil–Petersson distance) between the induced metrics on the boundary of the convex core, or between the left and right hyperbolic metrics?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a closed orientable surface of genus $g\ge 2$, and let $M = S\times\mathbb{R}$ be a globally hyperbolic maximal compact (GHMC) anti-de Sitter 3-manifold, i.e. a maximal Lorentzian 3-manifold of constant sectional curvature $-1$ that contains a closed Cauchy surface diffeomorphic to $S$. By a theorem of Mess, the moduli space of such structures is naturally parametrized by $\mathcal{T}(S)\times\mathcal{T}(S)$, where $\mathcal{T}(S)$ is the Teichmüller space of $S$; the two factors are the "left" and "right" hyperbolic metrics $(h_L,h_R)$ associated to $M$. The convex core $C(M)\subset M$ is the smallest non-empty closed convex subset whose inclusion is a homotopy equivalence; when $M$ is not Fuchsian, $C(M)$ is a compact 3-manifold with two boundary components, each homeomorphic to $S$, carrying induced hyperbolic metrics $(m_+,m_-)\in\mathcal{T}(S)\times\mathcal{T}(S)$. Let $V(M)$ denote the total volume of $M$ (when finite, e.g. for the convex core's enlargement; here interpreted as the volume of $C(M)$ if $M$ has infinite volume) and let $V(C(M))$ denote the volume of the convex core.

Recall that two non-negative functions $F,G$ on a space $X$ are quasi-equivalent if there exist constants $A\ge 1$ and $B\ge 0$ such that $A^{-1}G(x)-B \le F(x)\le A\, G(x)+B$ for all $x\in X$.

Question: Is either $V(M)$ or $V(C(M))$, viewed as a function on $\mathcal{T}(S)\times\mathcal{T}(S)$, quasi-equivalent to a natural distance — for instance the Teichmüller distance $d_{\mathcal T}$ or the Weil–Petersson distance $d_{WP}$ — between the induced convex-core boundary metrics $m_+$ and $m_-$, or between the left and right hyperbolic metrics $h_L$ and $h_R$?
artifact.category_tag: Anti-de Sitter geometry and Teichmüller theory
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results are known. It has been proved that $V(M)$ and $V(C(M))$ are coarsely equivalent for GHMC AdS manifolds, and that the volume is bounded below by an exponential of the Weil–Petersson distance between the left and right hyperbolic metrics (Bonsante–Seppi and related work), in analogy with Brock's theorem in the quasi-Fuchsian case. A full quasi-equivalence (two-sided linear bound) with a Teichmüller-theoretic distance has not been established in general; the question remains open in this stronger form.

status_evidence.title: On the volume of Anti-de Sitter maximal globally hyperbolic three-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: The volume of a GHMC AdS manifold and the volume of its convex core are coarsely equivalent; the volume is bounded below by the exponential of the Weil-Petersson distance.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results: V(M) and V(C(M)) are coarsely equivalent and bounded below by exp of WP distance, but full quasi-equivalence is not established.

status_evidence.title: Length functions in Teichmüller and anti-de Sitter geometry
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of length functions and metric comparisons in GHMC AdS geometry related to Teichmüller theory.
status_evidence.claim: Active research relating AdS volumes to Teichmüller-theoretic distances.

status_evidence.title: Riemannian metrics on the moduli space of GHMC anti-de Sitter structures
status_evidence.snippet: Pressure metric on the deformation space of GHMC AdS structures; Fuchsian locus is totally geodesic with a multiple of the Weil–Petersson metric.
status_evidence.claim: Connections between GHMC AdS moduli and Weil–Petersson geometry are known but do not resolve the quasi-equivalence question.
